name: Glaucous-Tombolo
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past subterranean ocean, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Nothing about signal of unknown origin appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.

For traders, dark crystals, water, carbon and helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
